Data:Talk.visitor.payment.language.crack.label: Tutoring: Cracktrack
Data:Talk.visitor.payment.language.crack.startdescription: My visitor can teach me the rudiments of the primal language that we rather underwhelmingly call 'Cracktrack' - because there is no name for that language in that language. [After tutoring you, the visitor will leave, even if they arrived on other business.]
Data:Talk.visitor.payment.language.crack.desc: I've learnt enough to puzzle out books in this language, though it might be slow going. [You can also use and improve this like any other skill.]

Data:Tanglebrag.json.Label: Tanglebrag
Data:Tanglebrag.json.Desc: A clot of wood, leaves and feathers that might draw the attention of the entity called Knotwingknot.

xexts.scrutiny: Not a knot… [There are Prentice-level Moth recipes - and one Lantern recipe - that can craft this.]

Data:Tapestry.thefoundationofthesun.json.Label: 'The Foundation of the Sun'
Data:Tapestry.thefoundationofthesun.json.Desc: 'Long ago in this country, one did not build a church without first sacrificing a white bull to the Sun-in-Rags…' Solomon Husher brought this tapestry with him from - well, wherever it was that Solomon came from.

xexts.scrutiny: The tapestry ripples very slowly, even in still air. Candle-flames bend towards it.
